one_line: Terry Ho's Yum Yum Sauce website with a split layout of product and food imagery, emphasizing versatility
typography: Handwritten serif logo; bold sans-serif main headings (large size jump), sans-serif body with red accents
layout_grid: Two-column split layout (product left, food right), centered header/footer, consistent vertical spacing
color_shape_legibility: Red background isolates product; yellow header highlights promotion; high-contrast 'SHOP NOW' button; split layout separates product and usage visuals
deck_transferable: 1. Two-column split to display product and its application (e.g., sauce bottle vs. food with sauce); 2. Bold, oversized sans-serif heading (e.g., 'Good On Everything') with smaller subheading for hierarchy; 3. Color blocking (vibrant red for product section, neutral for food section) to create visual separation; 4. Prominent call-to-action button (e.g., 'SHOP NOW') with high contrast (white text on black background); 5. Handwritten brand logo as a unique visual identifier
web_only_skip: Scroll functionality, hover state interactions, 3D product rendering, animated transitions between sections
